root_idea.summary: The root centers on producing a voiced cry or call.
root_idea.development: The underlying notion of vocal sound develops into directed calling or hallooing: a shepherd's cry, a loud Quranic summons, urging people onward, and calling after beasts.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I perfect citation form نَعَقَ rather than the Quranic imperfect يَنْعِقُ.

senses.definition: To cry out or call aloud.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction at 2:171, the call is presented as a loud summons or shout received without meaningful comprehension, rather than as intelligible speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To halloo or urge people onward toward fighting or strife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the supplied expression نَعَقَ بِهِمْ إِلَى الفِتْنَةِ, with a group as the directed object and a destination or cause introduced by إِلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who drives beasts away and cries out after them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A role noun describing a person who drives beasts while calling after them.
